title: Two notices still say 'OK' though the app's rule is never 'OK'
what: The app's one-button notice is meant to name what the button does ('Close', never 'OK'). Two notices skip that and show 'OK': the stop message when leaving a gym with open orders, and 'Could not remove the demo'.
expected: Every notice uses the same 'Close' button word.
fix_line: Use the shared notice helper in both places
